# Proverbs 4 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Listen up, children — a father is speaking. Pay attention so you can really understand.

**2** What I'm giving you is solid gold — don't throw it away.

**3** I was once a boy too — my father's child, my mother's precious one.

**4** And my father taught me. He said, 'Hold tight to what I tell you. Do what I say, and you'll truly live.

**5** Go after wisdom. Chase understanding. Don't forget what I've said, and don't turn your back on it.

**6** Don't abandon wisdom — she'll protect you. Love her, and she'll watch over you.

**7** Here's the most important thing: get wisdom! Whatever else you pursue, pursue understanding.

**8** If you hold her in high regard, she'll lift you up. If you embrace her, she'll bring you honor.

**9** She'll crown your head with grace and present you with a beautiful garland.'

**10** Listen, my child. Take in what I'm saying, and you'll live a long, full life.

**11** I've shown you the path of wisdom. I've guided you along straight roads.

**12** When you walk this way, nothing will hold you back, and when you need to run, you won't trip.

**13** Grab hold of discipline and don't let go — it's your lifeline.

**14** Don't set foot on the road that wicked people travel. Don't even walk in the direction evil people go.

**15** Stay away from it entirely. Don't go near it. Turn around and keep moving.

**16** Those people can't rest unless they've done something wrong — they lose sleep if they haven't dragged someone else down.

**17** Wrongdoing is their daily bread, and violence is the wine they drink.

**18** But the road of those who do right is like the first light of morning — it keeps getting brighter until the day is fully shining.

**19** The path of the wicked is pitch black. They stumble without even knowing what tripped them.

**20** My child, give your full attention to what I say. Lean in close and listen to every word.

**21** Don't let these words out of your sight. Keep them right at the center of who you are.

**22** They bring life to everyone who discovers them, and health to the whole body.

**23** Guard your heart more than anything else, because everything you do flows from it.

**24** Get rid of dishonest words. Don't let your mouth say anything twisted or misleading.

**25** Keep your eyes focused straight ahead. Fix your gaze on what's right in front of you.

**26** Think carefully about every step you take, and your whole direction will be solid.

**27** Don't drift to the right or the left. Keep your feet far from evil.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **4:7**: This sounds circular on purpose — it's saying the first wise thing you can do is decide you want to be wise. That decision is itself the beginning.

- **4:18**: One of the most hopeful images in the Bible — the idea that the life of a good person just keeps getting brighter, like a sunrise that never stops.

- **4:23**: This is the single most important piece of practical advice in the book. Everything — every word, every action, every relationship — starts in the heart.

— PNEUMA
